report_name: Florida DMV Notifies Drivers of Data Breach; ShinyHunters Claims Leak

threat_actors.name: ShinyHunters
threat_actors.description: A financially motivated extortion group that claimed responsibility for the Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles (FLHSMV) data breach. The group is known for large-scale data breaches and selling stolen data on dark web forums, and alleged the theft of over 500,000 files in this incident.
threat_actors.goals: To monetize the data breach through direct extortion or by selling the stolen data.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attacker gained initial access to the Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles (FLHSMV) records and exfiltrated data by logging in with legitimate, but stolen, credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: The attacker exfiltrated a large volume of files, claimed to be over 500,000, from the FLHSMV network to an external location.

identities.name: Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
identities.description: The Florida state government agency responsible for driver and vehicle services that suffered a data breach due to compromised credentials, leading to the potential exposure of driver data.

identities.name: Florida Residents
identities.description: Drivers in Florida whose personal data, including names, addresses, and dates of birth, was potentially compromised in the FLHSMV data breach.

indicators.name: Anomalous Large Volume Data Egress
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Large Volume Data Egress
id: 2b9c1f8a-7d3e-4b9c-8a1d-9c3e8a1d9c3e
status: experimental
description: Detects an unusually large volume of outbound data transfer from a single source, which could indicate data exfiltration as described in the FLHSMV breach. Thresholds should be tuned for the specific environment.
references:
  - https://tech-insider.org/florida-dmv-data-breach-shinyhunters-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-17
tags:
  - attack.t1048
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    SentBytes: '>1000000000' # Example threshold for >1GB
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate large data transfers, such as backups or large file sharing.
indicators.description: Detects anomalous large outbound data transfers, which could indicate data exfiltration similar to the activity claimed by ShinyHunters in the FLHSMV breach.

relationships.target_name: Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles

relationships.source_name: Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
